environment.description: Service deployed on EKS with CRYPTO_BACKEND=pkcs11 and HSM_SLOT_ID=1. Pod runs with Thales Luna Network HSM client configured via persistent volume mount at /etc/Chrystoki.conf. The PKCS#11 provider library (libCryptoki2_64.so) is loaded at startup. All signing operations are dispatched to the HSM via the PKCS#11 session; the _local_sign() code path with the null dereference is unreachable because self._backend is always 'pkcs11'. The _hsm_sign() method has an explicit None check on the handle and raises HTTPException(500) safely. Pod securityContext sets readOnlyRootFilesystem=true and drops ALL capabilities. Network policy restricts egress to HSM appliance IP on port 1792 only. Service account has no AWS IAM permissions (IRSA not configured).
